title: Zesty Middle Eastern Black Pudding Pilaf
description: A light and flavorful Middle Eastern dish featuring black pudding, served in a terracotta dish. This shojin-friendly pilaf is perfect for a quick and easy lunch.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large terracotta dish over medium heat.
Add the mustard seeds and cumin seeds and cook until fragrant.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the paprika and salt and cook for 1 minute.
Add the crumbled black pudding and cook until lightly browned.
Add the basmati rice and cook until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add 4 cups of water to the dish and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and cover the dish with a lid.
Simmer for 20 minutes or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
